title: Like Exploring the Landmarks with a Knowledgeable Local Friend
text: We had an incredible time on our tour exploring both Tossa de Mar and Girona.  Kudos to our tour guide, Alexandria, who was wonderful and managed our tight timeline effortlessly. The vibe was super laid-back and conversational, making it feel more like exploring with a knowledgeable friend than being on a strict schedule. We walked away with a full stomach and a much deeper appreciation for the local history and landmarks. Thank you, Alexandria, for such a memorable and enriching day!
author: jenniferdB3301UZ

title: Great day
text: I booked this tour last minute as a cruise ship passenger and was able to adapt the program exactly to my liking. The Cathedral in Girona was closed because they were shooting a movie there but I‘m still glad I got to see the outside at least. Also Tossa de Mar is beautiful. The guide also was very forthcoming with pictures and took many more great shots than I would have dared to ask for. For one person it wasn’t cheap but I enjoyed it much more than I would have enjoyed another rushed shore excursion with dozens of other people. Highly recommend the tour and the company
author: Christina_G

title: Highly Recommended – Amazing Experience!
text: We had an absolutely wonderful day! Everything was perfectly organized, and the tour was the ideal combination of history, breathtaking scenery, and relaxing time by the coast. Girona is a beautiful city full of charm, and Tossa de Mar is simply stunning. Our guide was friendly, knowledgeable, and made the experience enjoyable from start to finish. The private tour allowed us to travel at a comfortable pace and really enjoy each stop without feeling rushed. author: dominar2017

title: Such a lovely day!
text: We had such a lovely day exploring! Everything was organised really great, and our driver was friendly, helpful and shared lots of interesting stories along the way. The views were amazing, especially in Tossa de Mar. A great experience that we would definitely recommend!
author: F8652NC_

title: It was the best decision
text: My boyfriend and I weren’t sure what to do in Barcelona, but everyone recommended Montserrat. Going on our own seemed complicated, so we booked this tour and it was the best decision! Everything was perfectly organized, and our lovely Ukrainian guide made the experience so positive. Highly recommend!
author: _S8074LN

title: The motorcycle tour was an unforgettable experience!
text:
The motorcycle tour was an unforgettable experience! 
We got to see some of the top spots and hidden gems along the way, and riding the motorcycle made it all feel even more exciting and unique. Everything was well organized, and the guide made the trip fun and safe. Highly recommend!
